title: Baby in Rocking Chair Outside House, 1930s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming candid snapshot of an infant warmly dressed in a knit sweater and frilly bonnet, sitting upright in a child-sized rocking chair padded with a blanket. The photo is taken outside on a sunny patio alongside clapboard house siding, offering a gentle glimpse of ordinary domestic life and early childhood in 1930s America.
